title: Activity Coefficients of Sodium Chloride and Potassium Chloride in Mixed Aqueous Solutions at 25 C
experimental_method: Isopiestic vapour-pressure equilibration at 25 C of NaCl-KCl mixtures against NaCl reference solutions in a desiccator with up to thirteen dishes; isopiestic ratio R = M/m.
uncertainties_stated: Duplicates agreed within 0.05% in isopiestic ratio or mean deviation of triplicates 0.03% or less; over about a hundred duplicates average deviation from the mean 0.016%.
quality_remarks: PDF is this paper (6 pages, begins at p. 662). Table IV prints M, x, R and the authors' alpha coefficients; the molalities of the individual solutions are not tabulated, only R at x (m = M/R). Table I gives full molalities for 11 solutions near 4 M. Temperature 25 C, scale not stated.
not_extracted_tables: Table II: parameters of eq 6 (fit parameters)
Table III: calculation of alpha_B and alpha_C at M~4 (derived; its x, R duplicate Table I)
Table V: smoothed values of alpha_B and alpha_C (smoothed/derived)
Tables on later pages (activity coefficients, smoothed/derived), see text

row_counts.Table IV: printed 75 data rows + 11 series label rows + 11 Mean rows (Series 6 has a Mean row only), written 97 rows after header (75 data, 11 label, 11 Mean)

extraction_notes: Text layer of Table IV was scrambled (rows split), so both tables were typed from the page images and compared token-wise to the text layer; the only mismatches were text-layer glitches (checked on zoomed crops). Sanity: Table I: mB+mC equals printed sum, M/(mB+mC) equals R, R decreases with x in each M. M carried forward and filled down. Series 6 in Table IV shows only the Mean row.
needs_pass2_reason: 1961 scan with scrambled text layer; tables typed from image so an independent second read is needed
pass2_diff: Tables I and IV: every pass-2 number occurs in pass 1; the pass-1-only numbers are the M values it filled down; the sign of one pct_delta cell is smudged (read -.01 by pass 2).
